name: led-togialed-3030-amber
description: TOGIALED TJ-S3030UG5W6TLC9Y-A5 3030 amber LED, 595 nm dominant (591 nm peak), 150 mA rated, 0.39 W, Vf 2.6 V typ at 150 mA (~2.4 V at 60 mA, extrapolated: MEASURE IT), 120 deg (LCSC C42389961)

vf_trim.description: forward-voltage offset in volts for this LED (bin/part spread); the series source V<ref>_trim also measures the LED current: probe i(V<ref>_trim)

spice.model:
* TOGIALED 3030 amber (AlInGaP). Only the 150 mA point is published (2.6 V typ); the model passes through it with N=2, RS=1.5 and lands at 2.42 V @ 60 mA. That extrapolation is the least trustworthy Vf here and is what a series ballast resistor depends on. Tempco -2.5 mV/K.
.model TJ3030_AMBER D(IS=1.726e-21 N=2.0 RS=1.5 EG=3.074 XTI=2 CJO=40p TT=5n BV=8)

metadata.rotation_note: Footprint has the anode at -x and the cathode at +x. JLCPCB's reel zero-orientation for this part is not yet verified: check the polarity in their placement preview on the first order and record the correction here.
